package handlers

import (
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

func mapCatalogBaseFields(id string, slug string, sourceKey string, status int, createdAt time.Time, updatedAt time.Time, fields queryfields.Set) map[string]any {
	out := map[string]any{}
	if fields.Has("id") {
		out["id"] = id
	}
	if fields.Has("slug") {
		out["slug"] = slug
	}
	if fields.Has("source_key") {
		out["source_key"] = sourceKey
	}
	if fields.Has("status") {
		out["status"] = status
	}
	if fields.Has("created_at") {
		out["created_at"] = createdAt
	}
	if fields.Has("updated_at") {
		out["updated_at"] = updatedAt
	}
	return out
}

func (h TrackHandler) mapTrackListResponse(r *http.Request, items []domain.Track, fields queryfields.Set) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	if items == nil {
		items = []domain.Track{}
	}
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	includeI18n := fields.Has("title") || fields.Has("description") || fields.Has("translations")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	for _, item := range items {
		var translations []domain.TrackI18n
		if includeI18n && h.GetUC.TrackI18n != nil {
			var err error
			translations, err = h.GetUC.TrackI18n.ListByTrack(r.Context(), item.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		result = append(result, buildTrackFields(item, translations, fields, lang))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (h CourseLevelHandler) mapLevelListResponse(r *http.Request, items []domain.CourseLevel, fields queryfields.Set) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	if items == nil {
		items = []domain.CourseLevel{}
	}
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	includeI18n := fields.Has("title") || fields.Has("description") || fields.Has("translations")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	for _, item := range items {
		var translations []domain.CourseLevelI18n
		if includeI18n && h.GetUC.LevelI18n != nil {
			var err error
			translations, err = h.GetUC.LevelI18n.ListByLevel(r.Context(), item.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		result = append(result, buildLevelFields(item, translations, fields, lang))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (h CourseGroupHandler) mapGroupListResponse(r *http.Request, items []domain.CourseGroup, fields queryfields.Set) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	if items == nil {
		items = []domain.CourseGroup{}
	}
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	includeI18n := fields.Has("title") || fields.Has("description") || fields.Has("translations")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	for _, item := range items {
		var translations []domain.CourseGroupI18n
		if includeI18n && h.GetUC.GroupI18n != nil {
			var err error
			translations, err = h.GetUC.GroupI18n.ListByGroup(r.Context(), item.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		result = append(result, buildGroupFields(item, translations, fields, lang))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func buildTrackFields(item domain.Track, translations []domain.TrackI18n, fields queryfields.Set, lang string) map[string]any {
	out := mapCatalogBaseFields(item.ID, item.Slug, item.SourceKey, item.Status, item.CreatedAt, item.UpdatedAt, fields)
	if fields.Has("lesson_read_access") {
		out["lesson_read_access"] = item.LessonReadAccess
	}
	if fields.Has("order") {
		out["order"] = item.Order
	}
	translation := selectTrackTranslation(translations, lang)
	if fields.Has("title") {
		out["title"] = translation.Title
	}
	if fields.Has("description") {
		out["description"] = translation.Description
	}
	if fields.Has("translations") {
		out["translations"] = mapTrackTranslationResponse(translations)
	}
	return out
}

func buildLevelFields(item domain.CourseLevel, translations []domain.CourseLevelI18n, fields queryfields.Set, lang string) map[string]any {
	out := mapCatalogBaseFields(item.ID, item.Slug, item.SourceKey, item.Status, item.CreatedAt, item.UpdatedAt, fields)
	if fields.Has("lesson_read_access") {
		out["lesson_read_access"] = item.LessonReadAccess
	}
	translation := selectLevelTranslation(translations, lang)
	if fields.Has("title") {
		out["title"] = translation.Title
	}
	if fields.Has("description") {
		out["description"] = translation.Description
	}
	if fields.Has("translations") {
		out["translations"] = mapLevelTranslationResponse(translations)
	}
	return out
}

func buildGroupFields(item domain.CourseGroup, translations []domain.CourseGroupI18n, fields queryfields.Set, lang string) map[string]any {
	out := mapCatalogBaseFields(item.ID, item.Slug, item.SourceKey, item.Status, item.CreatedAt, item.UpdatedAt, fields)
	if fields.Has("lesson_read_access") {
		out["lesson_read_access"] = item.LessonReadAccess
	}
	translation := selectGroupTranslation(translations, lang)
	if fields.Has("title") {
		out["title"] = translation.Title
	}
	if fields.Has("description") {
		out["description"] = translation.Description
	}
	if fields.Has("translations") {
		out["translations"] = mapGroupTranslationResponse(translations)
	}
	return out
}

func selectTrackTranslation(translations []domain.TrackI18n, lang string) domain.TrackI18n {
	if lang != "" {
		for _, translation := range translations {
			if translation.Language == lang {
				return translation
			}
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if translation.Title != "" || translation.Description != "" {
			return translation
		}
	}
	return domain.TrackI18n{}
}

func selectLevelTranslation(translations []domain.CourseLevelI18n, lang string) domain.CourseLevelI18n {
	if lang != "" {
		for _, translation := range translations {
			if translation.Language == lang {
				return translation
			}
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if translation.Title != "" || translation.Description != "" {
			return translation
		}
	}
	return domain.CourseLevelI18n{}
}

func selectGroupTranslation(translations []domain.CourseGroupI18n, lang string) domain.CourseGroupI18n {
	if lang != "" {
		for _, translation := range translations {
			if translation.Language == lang {
				return translation
			}
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if translation.Title != "" || translation.Description != "" {
			return translation
		}
	}
	return domain.CourseGroupI18n{}
}

func mapTrackTranslationResponse(translations []domain.TrackI18n) []map[string]any {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"track_id":    translation.TrackID,
			"i18n_id":     translation.I18nID,
			"lang":        translation.Language,
			"title":       translation.Title,
			"description": translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapLevelTranslationResponse(translations []domain.CourseLevelI18n) []map[string]any {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"level_id":    translation.LevelID,
			"i18n_id":     translation.I18nID,
			"lang":        translation.Language,
			"title":       translation.Title,
			"description": translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapGroupTranslationResponse(translations []domain.CourseGroupI18n) []map[string]any {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"group_id":    translation.GroupID,
			"i18n_id":     translation.I18nID,
			"lang":        translation.Language,
			"title":       translation.Title,
			"description": translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}
